questions.Description: Identify and classify different types of inks (e.g., solvent-based, water-based, UV curable) based on their properties and applications.
Measure the viscosity of different inks using aviscometer.
Analyze the flow properties of inks using arheometer.
Measure the thickness of ink films on various substrates using a micrometer or other thickness gauges.
Evaluate the drying time of different ink sunder various drying conditions.
Conduct adhesion tests to assess the ink’s ability to adhere to different substrates.
